title: Offer bi soppi ëlëg
intro: Bi nit ñi di sooga xew, ruuh dafa daan joxe kado ak yéene yu sell. Waaye, ci ñeel gi nekkoon ci lëndëmu nangu gi. Gis leen jaar-jaaru nit kii nga xamni njubteem ak njeexte lu tiis la, te Yàlla feeñal ko ba fàww.
clues: Man bokk naa ci ñi njëkka am àdduna.
Ma jébbal sama Boroom sarax, mu nangu ko ci ngërëm.
Saraxu sama rak, ñu bañ ko, kiñaan lëndëm xolam.
Ma ne ko, 'Soo tàllalee sa loxo ci man ngir ray ma, duma tàllal sama loxo ngir ray la; Maa ngi ragal Yàlla, boroom àdduna.»
Mooy ki ñu njëkka ray ci àdduna bi.
Sama deret di yuuxu, man maa njëkka ñàkk seen bakkan ndax amul benn bàkkaar.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
